mechanism_narrative: The latest jump in GROCERY_PHARM and the concurrent easing in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates households are doing more local errand travel and fewer discretionary commutes, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as nearby shopping trips substitute for longer trips.
evidence_refs: fact:t-0w GROCERY_PHARM is -18.6 versus -24.1 at t-1w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to its last-28-day mean despite further improvement in GROCERY_PHARM and no renewed drop in TRANSIT or WORKPLACES, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week recovery in PARKS visits signals improving willingness to leave home for discretionary activities, and that same confidence translates into higher retail and restaurant traffic within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 8 points after being below 7 points in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from 6.6 at t-1w to 9.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If a PARKS rebound above the stated threshold is followed by flat or lower RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve together, commuting density returns and produces spillover spending at lunch, after-work, and weekend retail locations, yielding higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -44.7 to -37.3 while TRANSIT improved from -31.3 to -25.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise but RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean over the next 28 days, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, sustained weakness in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES suppresses discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC remains lower or falls further over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -25 and WORKPLACES stays below -35 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -25.0 and WORKPLACES was -37.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the stated thresholds, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in RESIDENTIAL mobility and PARKS mobility reflects more time spent near home plus local leisure activity, which redirects demand to neighborhood retail and raises RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive at 5.1 while PARKS returned to 9.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL and PARKS both remain elevated but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent upswing in PARKS is a proxy for favorable weather or seasonal outdoor activity, and that seasonal demand shift supports more shopping and dining trips, pushing RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above 8 for at least two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is 9.4 at t-0w after 6.6 at t-1w
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above 8 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week average over the next 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising GROCERY_PHARM and falling TRANSIT indicates more short, essential trips and fewer long transit-linked commutes; that pattern supports retail convenience visits and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves while TRANSIT remains at least 5 points below the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -24.1 to -18.6 while TRANSIT improved only from -31.3 to -25.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, or if TRANSIT also rebounds sharply and retail still falls, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under reopening conditions, a broad easing in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT should spill into discretionary spending by increasing foot traffic around commercial districts, causing RETAIL_REC to be higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both series improved at t-0w relative to t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue improving but RETAIL_REC remains below the last-28-day mean after four weeks, the hypothesis fails.
